reason: A file-attachment plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stages user-selected files in the workspace, displays attachment cards, and references them in subsequent conversation requests.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件选择、拖放和粘贴附件功能，并将文件暂存到工作区后关联到后续对话请求中。
summaries.en: Adds file picker, drag-and-drop, and paste attachments to DeepSeek Harness, staging files in the workspace and associating them with subsequent conversation requests.

capabilities: Accepts files through picker, drag-and-drop, and paste
Writes staged files under the session workspace at .dsh/uploads/
Reads staged files for preview and attachment references
Deletes staged files when users remove attachments
Injects pending attachment references into the next model request
